mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT OPERATOR_CODE as operatorCode, MEMBER_CODE as memberCode, ACTIVITY_NAME as activityName, PROFILE_IMAGE as profileImage, CREATOR_INTRODUCTION as creatorIntroduction, ACTIVITY_REGION as activityRegion FROM CREATOR WHERE ACTIVITY_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR CREATOR_INTRODUCTION LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' ORDER BY OPERATOR_CODE DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 3

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT CLASS_CODE as classCode, OPERATOR_CODE as operatorCode, CATEGORY_CODE as categoryCode, NAME as name, PRICE as price, ADDRESS as address, SINGLE_INTRODUCE as singleIntroduce, STAR_RATING_AVG as starRatingAvg FROM CLASS
WHERE NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR INTRODUCE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR CLASS_CODE IN ( SELECT CLASS_CODE FROM TAG WHERE TAG_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
ORDER BY CLASS_CODE DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 4

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM rnum, c.* FROM ( SELECT OPERATOR_CODE as operatorCode, MEMBER_CODE as memberCode, ACTIVITY_NAME as activityName, PROFILE_IMAGE as profileImage, CREATOR_INTRODUCTION as creatorIntroduction, ACTIVITY_REGION as activityRegion FROM CREATOR WHERE ACTIVITY_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR CREATOR_INTRODUCTION LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' ORDER BY OPERATOR_CODE DESC ) c WHERE ROWNUM <= #{endNum} ) WHERE rnum >= #{startNum}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM rnum, c.* FROM ( SELECT CLASS_CODE as classCode, OPERATOR_CODE as operatorCode, CATEGORY_CODE as categoryCode, NAME as name, PRICE as price, ADDRESS as address, SINGLE_INTRODUCE as singleIntroduce, STAR_RATING_AVG as starRatingAvg FROM CLASS WHERE NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR INTRODUCE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR CLASS_CODE IN ( SELECT CLASS_CODE FROM TAG WHERE TAG_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' ) ORDER BY CLASS_CODE DESC ) c WHERE ROWNUM <= #{endNum} ) WHERE rnum >= #{startNum}
SELECT CLASS_CODE as classCode, NAME as name, PRICE as price, ADDRESS as address FROM CLASS WHERE OPERATOR_CODE = #{operatorCode} ORDER BY CLASS_CODE DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CLASS WHERE NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR INTRODUCE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR CLASS_CODE IN ( SELECT CLASS_CODE FROM TAG WHERE TAG_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CREATOR WHERE ACTIVITY_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR CREATOR_INTRODUCTION LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
SELECT CLASS_IMG_CODE as classImgCode, CLASS_CODE as classCode, TYPE as type, IMAGE as image, SORT_ORDER as sortOrder FROM CLASS_IMAGE WHERE CLASS_CODE = #{classCode} ORDER BY SORT_ORDER ASC
